stories.headline: Nvidia tells partners to pause server shipments to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Indonesia after new US licence rule
stories.summary: Nvidia halted shipments to four Southeast Asian countries after the US closed a remote-access loophole that helped Chinese firms reach advanced AI chips. Singapore's deputy PM says it is talking to Washington to keep chip access and has not confirmed the halt.

stories.headline: XPeng unveils IRON humanoid and Turing Physical AI architecture (VLA 3.0), targets mass production and EV-level pricing
stories.summary: XPeng showed its IRON general-purpose humanoid and Turing architecture, with mass production targeted for around January 2027. The company says it may sell near an EV's median price, and store-assistant trials are planned for Q1 2027.

stories.headline: US chip curbs and distillation crackdown slow Chinese AI models; Z.ai's GLM-5.5 reportedly delayed
stories.summary: Reuters sources say US chip controls and curbs on distillation are hampering Chinese AI development. Z.ai's flagship GLM-5.5 missed its November release and could slip to Q1 2027 or later.
